title: Fix the Even Number Filter
description: The program should collect only the even numbers from a list. Fix the bug.
buggyCode:
numbers = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6]
evens = [n for n in numbers if n % 2 == 1]
print(evens)
expectedBehavior: The program should print [2, 4, 6], the even numbers.
actualProblem: n % 2 == 1 is true for odd numbers, not even ones, so the comprehension collects the wrong half of the list.
correctedCode:
numbers = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6]
evens = [n for n in numbers if n % 2 == 0]
print(evens)
explanation: A number is even when dividing it by 2 leaves no remainder, i.e. n % 2 == 0. The condition in the original code checks for the opposite case (remainder of 1), which selects odd numbers instead.
